title: Deep Nets with Subsampling Layers Unwittingly Discard Useful Activations at Test-Time
mechanism: Stride-2 layers drop 3 of 4 phases; search and aggregate the discarded activations at test time.
adaptation: A 1-2 px crack falls on one stride phase in the RN34 stem and maxpool; cheap version is 1 px shift TTA (0,1),(1,0),(1,1) with exact un-shift; full version is their phase search on stem and maxpool.
min_experiment: Arm: shift/phase TTA on 5 singles. Baseline: D4 TTA arm. Metric: crack IoU, components >= 20 px. Kill: < +0.003 over D4 TTA.
evidence: R: consistent test-time gains for classification and semantic segmentation over nine architectures, complementary to standard TTA.
